title: perf(mobile): thread detail screen and navigation sidebar compile with the React Compiler
body:
The React Compiler skipped the thread detail screen (which hosts the feed, composer and overlays), the tablet/foldable thread navigation sidebar, and the list's shelf preferences hook.

| File | Was skipped for | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `ThreadDetailScreen` | `.value =` on SharedValues passed to hooks; draft-message and end-follow refs written during render; `try`/`catch` around a conditional in the edit-pending handler | `.set()`; refs written in layout effects (their reads are in timers and handlers); the handler is a promise chain |
| `ThreadNavigationSidebar` | settled-list reset key kept in a ref read during render | state, adjusted during render |
| `use-thread-list-v2-shelf-preferences` | shelf-expanded refs written during render | written in a layout effect |

**Frozen-clock fix in `ThreadNavigationSidebar`.** This is the same shape as Home in [#21133](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/21133): list derivations read `new Date()` during render, and a snooze-wake timer re-arms off their output. The clock is now state, advanced by the minute interval and by the wake timer.

Manual `useMemo`/`useCallback`/`memo` are removed from all three files. `KNOWN_BAILOUTS`: 18 → 15.

**Verified on device** (Pixel 9 API 36 emulator, isolated server, real Claude provider):
- **Thread detail**: sent a turn and queued a follow-up while it ran. Both replied; the queued one ran on its own.
- **Home**: expanded and collapsed the Settled shelf (the shelf-preferences toggle).
- No red box, and no `useMemoCache` or React errors in the Metro log.
- The sidebar only shows on wide layouts. This phone-sized emulator renders the compact list, so the sidebar was not on screen.

**Renders while a reply streams in the open thread** (`measure-renders` stream scenario, median of 3, same base and device):

| | Before | After |
|---|---:|---:|
| renders | 1773 | 1714 |
| commits | 41 | 38 |
| runs | 1296 / 1773 / 2012 | 1714 / 1720 / 1674 |

No measurable change in the median. The spread is narrower after, but with three runs and variable provider output I wouldn't read anything into that. `ThreadFeed` is still on `KNOWN_BAILOUTS`, and it is the biggest remaining lever for streaming.

## Review follow-up

- Shelf toggles call `savePreferences({ transform })`, which reads the optimistic value, so the three `*ShelfExpandedRef` syncs are gone. `draftMessageRef` is gone (the artifact-template append is idempotent, so props are enough). `endFollowEnabledRef` is written where follow state changes instead of in a layout effect. Pending-message edit uses `settlePromise`.
- On device: Settled shelf toggles once per tap. Two taps in the same frame leave it unchanged and three flip it, so rapid toggles don't collapse into one write.

![Settled shelf expanded](https://gh-file-drop-api-prod-mi5fy3sowv63ufte.pinglabs.workers.dev/f/4100ee2db7b0f84b/rf-7.png)

Device: Pixel 9 API 36 emulator on nucbox-1, client rebuilt from `perf/mobile-compile-8` (the old one lacked the `T3FoldPosture` native view), Metro and an isolated seeded server on cups.
